subject: MAP: Integration Build Canvas & Owner Commitments
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Summers <elliot.summers@healthlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: MAP: Integration Build Canvas & Owner Commitments

Thanks again for the time today, Elliot — appreciate the clear session on priorities. As promised, attaching a first-pass MAP page focused on the "Integration Build" milestone so we can lock owners and dependencies. High level recap below and a suggested owner roster.

Quick recap (post-demo):
- Primary success metric: reduce inference latency variance below 150ms P95 for patient-facing flows (avg seq length ~512).
- Must-have: streaming + tool-calling support for real-time data enrichment.
- Compliance ask: traffic must stay in us-east-1 and logs retained 90 days.

Integration Build (MAP) — draft milestone items and owners
1) SDK integration and test harness
   - Owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood)
   - Deliverable: language SDK + sample app, unit tests, CI template
   - ETA: 3 weeks from sign-off
2) Streaming & KV cache validation
   - Owner: Priyom Das (Redwood)
   - Deliverable: end-to-end load test results, config recommendations
   - Dependencies: HealthLytics staging data, closed-network access
3) Tool-calling adapters (EHR lookup + billing connector)
   - Owner: Vanessa Ortiz (Redwood)

From: Elliot Summers <elliot.summers@healthlytics.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Bell <marcus.bell@healthlytics.com>, procurement@healthlytics.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration Build Canvas & Owner Commitments

Thanks Rachel — this is really helpful. Quick notes from our side:
- Confirmed: staging datasets available next Monday (2026-06-28). Marcus (cc'd) will be our tech lead for the integration.
- Procurement: we can sign the SOW once we validate the streaming SLA in staging; procurement contact on this thread.
- Target: aiming for a production pilot by 2026-08-15, so ~7 weeks after staging access. Please flag anywhere that would push that date.

Action items for Redwood to confirm:
- Exact network egress/IP ranges required for VPC peering
- List of storage/audit log retention controls you can turn on per-tenant
- A short dev-run checklist for Marcus to run in staging (or point to an existing checklist)

Elliot

Subject: Re: MAP: Integration Build Canvas & Owner Commitments

Great — thanks Elliot and Rachel. Adding some concrete commitments and a working checklist so Marcus can get started immediately. I've uploaded the SDK integration checklist and a sample Postman collection to the shared Drive link. Highlights below:

SDK integration checklist (owner: Marissa)
- Repo scaffolding: sample app (node + python) and CI (GitHub Actions)
- Auth: API key rotation guidance + recommended header examples
- Structured outputs: JSON schema v1.2 for EHR enrichment responses (see Drive)
- Test harness: local mock + staging workload runner (commands included)

Streaming / KV (owner: Priyom)
- Expected memory profile for seq length 512: ~6GB/session on xlarge instances
- Suggest initial batch/windowing: 32ms token pacing to avoid token-echo under streaming
- Dependency: need KV prefix keys from Marcus for end-to-end validation

Tool-calling adapters (owner: Vanessa)
- Will provide connector stubs for HealthLytics' EHR and Billing APIs (OAuth flow + sample payloads)
- ETA for stubs: 5 business days after staging access

Attachments in Drive: SDK checklist (sdk-integration-checklist.xlsx), HealthLytics_MAP_v1.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cHealthLytics-MAP

Marissa

2) Priyom to run streaming/KV smoke tests in Redwood staging with HealthLytics test keys week of 2026-06-29. Need Marcus to share KV key prefixes and test accounts.
3) Vanessa will drop tool-calling connector stubs by 2026-07-06.
4) Procurement/contract: Rachel to send updated SOW and DocuSign link when staging validation passes.
